options.name: default
options.description: Sets the retention policy as default retention policy.

options.name: duration
options.description: Determines how long InfluxDB should keep the data. If specified, it should be V(INF) or at least one hour. If not specified, V(INF) is assumed. Supports complex duration expressions with multiple units. Required only if O(state) is set to V(present).

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address on which InfluxDB server is listening.

options.name: password
options.description: Password that is used to authenticate against InfluxDB server.

options.name: path
options.description: The path on which InfluxDB server is accessible. Only available when using python-influxdb >= 5.1.0.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which InfluxDB server is listening.

options.name: proxies
options.description: HTTP(S) proxy to use for Requests to connect to InfluxDB server.

options.name: replication
options.description: Determines how many independent copies of each point are stored in the cluster. Required only if O(state) is set to V(present).

options.name: retries
options.description: Number of retries client performs before aborting. V(0) indicates try until success. Only available when using C(python-influxdb) >= 4.1.0.

options.name: shard_group_duration
options.description: Determines the time range covered by a shard group. If specified it must be at least one hour. If not provided, it is determined by InfluxDB by the rentention policy's duration. Supports complex duration expressions with multiple units.

options.name: ssl
options.description: Use https instead of http to connect to InfluxDB server.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Number of seconds Requests waits for client to establish a connection.

options.name: udp_port
options.description: UDP port to connect to InfluxDB server.

options.name: use_udp
options.description: Use UDP to connect to InfluxDB server.

options.name: username
options.description: Username that is used to authenticate against InfluxDB server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to V(false), the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to V(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
